title: Odd-branch preservation for zero
statement: Let a nondeterministic register program have a state $l$ whose instruction branches on whether register $r$ is odd, with successor states $l_1$ for odd and $l_0$ for even. If the current configuration $(l,v,	ext{no answer})$ satisfies the guard, the value of register $r$ is even, and the configuration $(l_0,v,	ext{no answer})$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $p$, then $(l,v,	ext{no answer})$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $p$.
